_about: Battery 5 (Figure 19 files): do the eleven severely affected (SA) donors drive the between-donor and clinical results of Batteries 1 to 4? This file belongs to Battery 5 only. Part12_01_config.json, Part12_Preset_Readings.md, Part12_03_Config.r and the Figure 15 to 18 analysis files are read, never changed.
why_separate_files: Battery 5 carries its own configuration and pre-set readings, so the Battery 1 to 4 files stay as they were run.

source_logs._note: Logs of the sections whose results Battery 5 retests. Section 26 checks that each log ended with PASS and that its analysis file is in Part12_rerun.

sa._note: The SEA-AD flag, read from obs_dataset.csv of every arm and region set (the same column Part 13a read). Values are compared after trimming and lower-casing.

high_adnc._note: The random-removal pool: donors of the same frame with ADNC_rank equal to this value and not severely affected. Every SA donor must carry this value.

seeds._note: Battery 5 seeds: master_seed + step code. The Battery 1 to 4 step seeds are used only to reproduce the 16B splits of the all-donor run (section 27), never for a new draw.

null._note: Random removal: per frame, as many donors as the frame has SA donors, drawn without replacement from the frame's high-ADNC donors that are not SA, `draws` times. A statistic is attenuated beyond random removal when its SA-removal change is below the `tail` quantile of its random-removal changes.

exposed._note: Rows retested without the eleven. Each entry: source panel, stats file folder and name, the level kept, and the quantities with a test (the rest are carried as descriptive rows).

not_retested._note: Left out, with the reason, so the scope is explicit.
not_retested.15B: the same clinical model as 15A with doublets removed; 15A carries the clinical exposure
not_retested.15C, 15D, 16C, 16D, 16E, 16G, 18B, 18C: cell-level or within-donor comparisons, low exposure to a donor-level shift
not_retested.17A between donors, 17C between donors,: 17C between donors is unreadable on PVM_3 and PVM_1 (VIF 5 or more); 17A and 17C are retested at the within-donor level named in the exposure table
not_retested.18D: a power simulation built from all donors; its donor numbers would change by construction

influence._note: Leave-one-donor-out, tables only: 16A, 16B and 16F between donors, every donor of the cohort removed in turn.
